note: Rules for npm run contrast. Pairs are built from token names, not listed one by one, so a new token falls into its rule by its name. Edit the lists here, never docs/contrast.md.

rules.what: Text and icon tokens named <role>-on-<role>, with or without -secondary or -tertiary, against the background of the same role and level, and its hover.
Every other text and icon token against each surface.
Every border token against each surface. The 3:1 minimum applies where the border is the only thing that marks a control (a field, a checkbox). A decorative border may fail it.
